name: band upright row (under two feet)
description: An upright row where the band is held under both feet. It builds the shoulders and upper traps.
instructions: Stand with both feet on the middle of the band and hold the ends in front of your thighs.
Keep your chest up and your core tight.
Pull your hands up along your body until they reach chest height, elbows leading.
Pause briefly without shrugging too high.
